title: BOC seizes P291-M worth of suspected shabu shipments at NAIA

blocks.text: The Bureau of Customs–Ninoy Aquino International Airport (BOC-NAIA) on Thursday said it has seized 42.884 kilograms of suspected shabu worth an estimated P291.61 million from three shipments originating from Kenya and Malaysia.
